comment: How each brand's own product types are used. Edit freely; the next ingest re-labels every product.
show_types: false hides the brand's own types on its brand page (use when they are colours, seasons or codes).
primary: the brand mainly sells this category, so anything the keyword rules call 'formal' or 'other' becomes it (shoe brands: 'MEN FORMAL' means formal shoes).
types: exact brand product type -> shared category; wins over every rule. Categories: unstitched, eastern, western, formal, footwear, bags-accessories, fragrance-beauty, home, other.
Drafted 2026-11-18 from the 31 selected brands' data; brands not listed use the keyword rules and show their types.
